content.short: rewrx - a project that gives back.
content.description:
rewrx was founded January 2022 with a mission of merging blockchain and nature for the greater good. Not only do we choose smaller, single pools to help keep the Cardano network decentralized, but we also donate a large portion of our earnings.

A portion of these profits are donated to eco conscious non-profit organizations, areas of the world that are struggling, disaster relief, and back into the Cardano ecosystem.
